THE FIRST CALLER IN A BLOCK SETS THE INDEXES EVERYONE ELSE USES. `accrue-and-cache` keys `index-cache` on `stacks-block-time` and returns the cached record to every later caller in that block, while the vault's `accrue` is itself a no-op once `last-update` equals the current time. Show attacker A calling first to fix an index favourable to A and unfavourable to victim B, then B's liquidation, borrow or repay in the same block executing against A's snapshot rather than a freshly accrued one. Impact: direct theft of user funds.'
